en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3541 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Salih, from Abu Abdullah (as).

He said: I asked him about a man who found a stolen animal that belonged to his neighbor, so he took it to return it to him, but the animal died.
Imam (as) said: "There is nothing (no liability) upon him."
